conventions: WD17 supersedes the in-task placement chosen for WD16.
Keep existing localized copy, native inputs and all task details.
Change only the generated-results completion journey; preserve the existing site layout.
One source writer or test runner; do not touch real voice services or physical devices.

packages.title: Show completion above the generated task group
packages.brief: Replace final-task placement with exactly one full-width banner immediately above the entire task list, outside all task cards. Keep existing heading, two-column desktop/single-column mobile layout and EN/ES/CA copy. Remove obsolete final-task placement state. Make completion noticeable when the final pointer/touch action is low in a tall result with the least intrusive conditional reveal: reveal only when offscreen, no focus call, honor reduced motion and do not scroll for undo or keyboard completion. Keyboard completion keeps native focus/context and announces once through the existing polite atomic status. Do not add controls, overlays, blank reserved space or repeated sticky obstruction. Independent prereview approves this modality-specific reveal tradeoff; respect sticky-header clearance. Allow natural scroll anchoring when content is inserted above the focused input, without reserving blank space.
acceptance: A nonempty fully checked result shows exactly one full-width completion banner as a sibling before the entire task list, outside every task card; initial, partial, zero-task, loading and error states show none.
Every existing task, title, date, note and question is unchanged and visible; desktop two-column/mobile single-column layout remains. Completion copy remains EN/ES/CA.

Final pointer/touch completion on tall narrow results makes the banner noticeable with a bounded one-time reveal only if needed, without changing native checkbox identity or focus. No repeated or undo scroll; reduced motion has no animated scrolling or reveal.

Keyboard Space retains the same checkbox node and focus, without forced completion scrolling; one existing polite atomic live status announces the complete localized feedback once. The visual banner adds no second live region.

Undo from any task hides the banner and keeps local toggles usable; identical new results, record/submission, Change text and close/reset clear completion. No API/status/quota/storage/account changes occur from toggles.

Affected states pass measured contrast, axe, target/focus, 320px, doubled text and spacing checks in all locales/themes on desktop/mobile. Existing WEB-801 badge overflow is distinguished from completion regressions.
Independent tester runs focused acceptance plus required type/legal/build/unit/full Playwright checks with exact exits, refreshes affected captures, and independent reviewer verifies fresh evidence.
deviceChecks: Native TalkBack/VoiceOver announcement and checkbox context.
Physical phone pointer/touch completion, undo and reduced-motion behavior; Safari/iPhone font rendering WEB-701.
